data.description: Discovered during bug 19a3-03ca-6c89-4e1b, code_version fb00f39f02f64511cae24fd9c9dfb3e747e78457. After the perf fix, all resolver paths are still O(N) but with low per-iteration cost (single Python process via the alias resolver). Current timings on 20K-dir tracker: 8-hex 286ms, prefix 1.5s, alias/jira 1.4s, 16-hex 150ms. An index file (under the tracker root or in plugin state) maintained by ticket-create / ticket-edit / ticket-transition on mutation would convert all resolver paths to O(1) lookups. Index must include archived/closed/deleted tickets so ticket show on an archived id continues to succeed. Mutations go through plugin scripts so a create/edit/transition hook suffices for index maintenance; fall back to scan if missing. Related: orphan-dir backlog 986d-4546-e65d-4a3c is the upstream driver of the O(N) ceiling. Ship as P2; the 13-minute symptom is already fixed.
data.title: [ticket-resolver]: linear scan over 20K dirs -> add lookup index for O(1) ID resolution
